site.title: Vardenia - Discover Lebanon
site.description: Lebanon's premium tourism and lifestyle guide: hotels, restaurants, experiences and hidden villages, curated and verified.

home.intro: Lebanon's tourism and lifestyle guide. Every place here is visited before it is printed, and every printed page carries a code that brings you back to this.
home.sectionsNote: Every listing belongs to exactly one, and the printed code on a table card resolves to the same section it was sold under. That is why the set does not change.
home.wholeDirectoryNote: Every listing, filtered how you like
home.listingsEmpty: The directory is still being built
home.listingsEmptyBody: We visit and verify each place before it appears here, so the first entries are still being worked through. The magazine is the faster way in for now.
home.businessTitle: Do you run somewhere in Lebanon?
home.businessBody: Getting listed starts with a visit. We handle the writing, the photography and the QR code that goes on your table cards.
home.printBody: Every place in the magazine carries a code. Point a phone at it and the listing opens, with the hours as they are today rather than as they were the day it printed.
home.printImageAlt: A printed Vardenia issue open on a table
